contentList.content: Master switch for trader and enemy loot processing.
Allows optional load-time and background scans over all currently loaded characters. Keep off for normal play.
If bulk scans are enabled, process currently loaded traders and enemies when a save or level loads.
Keep the current randomized loot and prevent automatic rerolls on load, MCM save, and periodic scans.
Apply To New Actors While Frozen
While frozen, process vendors and enemies that have never been randomized, without rerolling already processed actors.
If bulk scans are enabled, periodically checks currently loaded characters for unprocessed traders and enemies.
Print processing details to the Script Extender console.
When a trader's inventory is generated, replace that trader's safe stock with random loot.
When a trader is processed, use a filtered random pool that excludes junk entries.
When a trader's inventory is generated, keep existing stock and add random stock once per long rest.
When Vendor++ is off, remove safe existing stock before adding random stock.
Remove duplicate non-stackable templates from processed vendors.
Number of random items added to each processed trader. This is not scaled by NPC level.
When a vendor loot mode runs, add extra revival, rest, injury, supply, and similar utility items to some processed traders.
Percent chance that a processed trader receives essential utility stock.
Number of essential utility items added when the essential stock chance succeeds.
Do not remove existing revival, rest, injury, supply, and similar utility items from processed traders.
When an enemy dies, add random loot to that enemy if it passes safety checks.
When a processed enemy dies, remove safe existing inventory before adding random loot.
Treat non-party non-trader NPCs as enemy loot targets when hostility cannot be detected.
Enemies receive 1 to floor(level / this value) + 1 random items.
Rewrite low-value or unknown modded item prices to rarity-based stat values.
When enabled, only mods listed below receive rarity-based price correction. When disabled, listed mods are exempt instead.
One mod UUID, mod name, or file-path fragment per line. Leave empty to apply to all modded items. Use # for comments.
Modded item stats below this value, or with unknown value, are rewritten to the rarity values below.
Gold value assigned to Common modded item stats below the threshold.
Gold value assigned to Uncommon modded item stats below the threshold.
Gold value assigned to Rare modded item stats below the threshold.
Gold value assigned to Very Rare modded item stats below the threshold.
Gold value assigned to Legendary modded item stats below the threshold.
Optional per-item rules. Use the Item Value Rules tab, or enter lines like STAT_NAME=lock or STAT_NAME=1200.
Do not delete or generate obvious quest, story, key, container, or plot-critical item templates.
Items created by combining are excluded from the random loot pool.
Vendor loot uses player level x 100; enemy loot uses enemy level x 100. Items with known value above that cap are skipped.
Allows root-template pool entries when no in-world item value is known.
Allow junk items in the random pool unless Filtered Vendor Stock is active.
